newsitem.title: USA: Water slide falls at Calif. park, 20 injured.
newsitem.headline: Water slide falls at Calif. park, 20 injured.

text.p: A water slide at a northern California amusement park collapsed on Monday, injuring at least 20 people, many of them teenagers on a graduation trip, authorities said.

About 10 of those injured were seriously hurt when part of the 40-foot (12 metre)-tall slide collapsed at Waterworld USA in Concord, about 30 miles (48 km) north-east of San Francisco, a spokesman for the American Medical Response ambulance service said.

"There are approximately 20 patients, and of that total 10 have suffered serious injuries," said American Medical Response spokesman Chuck McFadden. "Of course that total may go up and down as the afternoon goes on."

Witnesses said the people on the slide came crashing to the ground when it collapsed, turning the pool of water beneath the slide red with blood. "We could hear it (collapse)," one witness told KCBS radio. "We could see everyone running."
